Scenario: AC7 A package that is not in the service's own module map fails the build (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC8 A cross-schema join, view or foreign key fails the build; a service never reads another service's schema (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC9 A local decision-log table is refused; a decision is recorded only through the decision-record library and topic rwb.decision-record.v1 (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC10 A direct event producer or consumer fails the build; events go only through the outbox and inbox library (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC11 A cross-service call uses the published REST contract /api/recovery/<short>/v1 with one hop, or a Temporal activity on the owner's queue; an internal package or a chain is refused (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC12 Reference data and authorise answers arrive only through the shared-library clients of RWB-PLT-E1043-CON and RWB-PLT-E1037-CON (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC13 An outbound file goes only through the rwb-integration adapter contract and the enterprise model endpoint only through the rwb-agent client (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC14 A screen reaches a service only through the gateway-bff composite route and no screen imports another service's screen (new, D-RCV-60)

Scenario: AC15 Generated code is never edited; the repository skeleton, module map loader, boundary test and pipeline come from the template (new, D-RCV-60)
